sloka: पलायनेन चोद्दिष्टाः प्राणान् रक्षामहे वयम्।एकेन बहवो भग्ना यशो नाशं गमिष्यति ।। ६.६६.२८ ।।
transliteration: palāyanena coddiṣṭāḥ prāṇān rakṣāmahe vayam।ekena bahavo bhagnā yaśo nāśaṁ gamiṣyati ।। 6.66.28 ।।

translations.english: "Even though we are distinguished, if we preserve our life by running away for life, destroyed by one, our glory will come to an end."
